2026-10-07T19:40:00.CONTENT_EN:
Hong Kong Cyclothon (11 Oct (Sun)) – Special Traffic and Transport Arrangements in the West Kowloon Cultural District

To facilitate the holding of the Hong Kong Cyclothon on 11 October (Sunday), Museum Drive and Cultural Drive in the West Kowloon Cultural District (WKCD) will be closed from 1am on the event day.

Bus stops, GMB stops, taxi stands (including taxi pick-up/drop-off points), fleet taxi stopping places and private carparks within the WKCD will be suspended until the roads reopen at around 1.15pm.

Members of the public and visitors heading for the WKCD are advised to use public transport services in the vicinity (such as railway, franchised bus, GMB and "water taxi" "Central - West Kowloon" route services).

For details of road closure on the event day, please refer to the Transport Department Notice:
(https://www.td.gov.hk/tc/traffic_notices/index_id_89116.html).
2026-10-07T19:40:00.CONTENT_CN:
香港單車節（十月十一日（星期日）-西九文化區特別交通及運輸安排

為配合十月十一日（星期日）舉行香港單車節，西九文化區內的博物館道及文化道將於活動當日凌晨一時分起封閉。

所有位於西九文化區內的巴士站、專線小巴站、的士站（包括的士上落客點）、車隊的士停車處及私人停車場亦將會暫停使用，直至道路在下午約一時十五分重開為止。

前往西九文化區的市民及旅客可使用附近的公共運輸服務（例如鐵路、專營巴士、專線小巴及水上的士「中環—西九龍」航線）。

有關活動當日封路的詳細資料，請參閱運輸署公告：
（https://www.td.gov.hk/tc/traffic_notices/index_id_89116.html）。
